talker_q4.quality_scope: Four short Russian phrases transcribed correctly; not a broad listening or multilingual quality benchmark
talker_q4.bf16_limitation: One captured input stalled in the previous BF16 CUDA expert multiplication path. Q4 completes it; the underlying BF16 kernel is not universally qualified.

evidence_period: 2026-10-11 through 2026-10-13; historical measurements, not rerun during release preparation

context.native_dialogue: five GPU speech turns; forced empty completion followed by a successful request in the same process

observation.test_scope: Synthetic camera/screen images; not a broad scene or physical portal qualification.

long_speech.unsegmented_failure: A separate 12-minute continuous Talker stress stream reached EOS with valid PCM but unintelligible final speech. The 600.97-second result is not a general speech-quality claim.
long_speech.implementation: src/voice.cpp groups complete phrases near 160 tokens with a 256-token word-boundary fallback. This is implemented in this native module.
long_speech.asr_scope: Two selected 28-second regions around a cache boundary and reply end transcribed successfully. The complete 600-second output was not listening-qualified.
long_speech.cache_growth_test: Predictor GPU: all KV bytes identical and hidden output <1e-5 against preallocated cache at positions 512, 1024, 1299
long_speech.phrase_join_test: 10ms overlap, no inserted silence, within-phrase samples unchanged

limitations: No listening-based, English or broad multilingual qualification.
Raw formulas degraded speech in one long test.
Input audio is a recorded turn, not continuous full-duplex microphone input.
Numerical fixtures do not establish general speech quality.
BF16 CUDA expert multiplication stalled on one input; Q4 passing it does not resolve the BF16 defect.
duplex_update: See DUPLEX_VALIDATION.json and DUPLEX.md for the 2026-10-16 opt-in session API. Historical turn-based measurements below are retained.
